description: This shell script manages the status LEDs on a device by identifying the appropriate LED to control and setting its state based on different system events such as preinit, failsafe, or completion.

methods.name: get_status_led
methods.description: Finds and sets the filename of the status LED, prioritizing non-amber/red LEDs.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets the LED state based on the argument, such as preinit, failsafe, or done.
